role: Line holder — the only unit that takes ground.
blurb: Cheap boots that move slow. The only unit that can plant a flag on a town or factory, so screen it with armor and let Recon find the lane.
The hammer — soaks hits and punches holes. Your flag rides in a Tank variant, so losing it ends the match. Objectives are the infantry's job, not the Tank's.
Glass with reach. Fires two to three hexes out and takes no reply at that range. Caught adjacent it dies fast — keep it behind the line.
Fast eyes. Outruns everything and ignores the worst terrain cost. Thin armor, light punch — it finds the fight and screens the flank.
